facts.fact: 医院醒来：下颌钢线、头部 cage、脊柱支架——背断七处、颅骨裂、下颌碎。
facts.anchor: my jaw was wired shut. My head in a cage. A spinal brace holding me together, my back broken in seven places

facts.fact: 失忆：给了笔和写字板问他是谁——全忘了。
facts.anchor: They gave me a pen and a board to write with, asked me who I was, but I couldn’t remember.

facts.fact: 从水里捞出时体温过低、临床死亡——缺氧神经损伤警告。
facts.anchor: hypothermic and clinically dead, that they had no idea how long I’d been under

facts.fact: 椅中岁月：被固定在窗边椅子上数月——「像被绑在那里」。
facts.anchor: parked by a fucking window for months and months and months, my arms, my legs fastened to that fucking thing

facts.fact: 恢复时间线：一年学走、两年去 frame、三年丢拐、五年跛行淡去。
facts.anchor: A full year passed before I began to learn to walk again. Two years before I didn’t need a frame.

facts.fact: 学法律：社区大学+夜间法学院——考 bar、clerking、爬进他们的律所。
facts.anchor: community college, law school by night. I passed the bar. I began clerking.

facts.fact: 制造偶遇——Grant 像看垃圾一样看他——直到他说出他需要的身份。
facts.anchor: I manufactured a meeting by happenstance. I extended my hand to Grant Walker

facts.fact: 二十年计划：把妻子一个个放进椅子里——像他们放我；剥夺 control。
facts.anchor: putting them in a chair, like they put me in one

facts.fact: 章末递枪：「站起来，Alex。拿枪、扣扳机——一切就结束了。」
facts.anchor: Take the gun, pull the trigger. And all this can be over.
